passages.text: wayfinder is the start for a decision space too large for one session, spanning more than one context: it charts that space as the map of a plan directory, and works it down until the way is clear. The map belongs to one planning change: propose its mode, careful, and wait, as AGENTS.md says for work that will be split, open its record with a `## start` section naming wayfinder and its front matter's `plan:` naming the plan directory, and chart and work the map as its frame step, which spans the sessions the map needs; at every stop the record's "next" line names the frontier item that resumes it. A single design that needs stress-testing is one change's frame; a settled compact change needs no map. The map's decision tickets are checklist items in `map.md`, never the plan's tickets: they become delivery work only through the plan step's `tickets.md` once the way is clear. The methods a ticket needs, frame's interview and its research and prototype references, are loaded through the harness's skill mechanism; when it has none, read the installed SKILL.md and its reference files.
